title: Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM (device lushan, board his9603, platform merak, MediaTek MT9676 / mt5896),
notes:
Hisense SmartTV 4K FFM (device lushan, board his9603, platform merak, MediaTek MT9676 / mt5896),
Google TV 12 (Android 12), firmware STT2.230929.001.092, security patch 2025-05-01. The Android model
string is "SmartTV 4K FFM", the same as examples/hisense-smarttv-4k-ffm/ (huangshan, Android TV 10) and
examples/hisense-smarttv-4k-ffm-android11/ (songshan); this is a third board with its own package set.
Mongolia, en-US locale.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/hisense-smarttv-4k-ffm-lushan/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/hisense-smarttv-4k-ffm-lushan/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED with pm disable-user, never uninstalled.

Applied on 2026-10-22 in four batches, with a reboot and a screenshot after each: normal boot, no
crashes, the HDMI input, Wi-Fi and the remote's buttons kept working. In use since, with the Clean
Your TV launcher as Home.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (the Google TV home). It is disabled by the
launcher install, not by this list; pass it to tools/restore.sh as the stock launcher.
Left ON by choice here (deliberately not in this list): Google Assistant (katniss), casting and
mirroring (Chromecast, AirPlay, Miracast, DLNA), the OTA updaters, Netflix, YouTube, Spotify, Twitch.
Never disabled: com.hisense.tv.smartsense, com.vt.tv.smartsense.ui, com.vt.tv.aiot. The huangshan FFM
list notes that disabling them sent that set to Android Recovery.
